title: Coalition Menuvame disability inclusion march
location: Central Skopje, march from Parliament to Government
scope: One-day public protest march in Skopje; the sources do not establish a multi-city event.
threshold_50_evidence: No participant count is reported in either opened account; threshold of 50 remains unresolved.

start_date.summary: Both accounts date the march to 15 October 2024.

location.summary: March began at Parliament and ended at Government in Skopje.

demands.summary: Inclusion, access to municipalities, hospitals, schools and ministries, social justice and equality; coded as public-policy demand.

participants_original.summary: No attendance figure in captured body.

state_target.summary: The march went to the Government and sought changes from public institutions.

state_response.summary: No response to the march established in captured coverage.

notes: The second account is a same-event report; not an independent headcount.
open_questions: Do either opened accounts report a contemporaneous count or other evidence establishing at least 50 people simultaneously at this march? The captured bodies contain no attendance figure.
Do the organizers explicitly direct a specific policy demand to the national Government or another own-state institution, beyond the reported march route and broad inclusion/access requests?

title: State attorneys’ protest for salary supplement
location: Gostivar court announced the protest; reports say actions were to take place across state attorney regional units.
scope: Two-hour protest action announced across state attorney regional offices; occurrence is confirmed, exact gathering locations and participant aggregation across offices are not reported.
threshold_50_evidence: No participant count is given. The 118 state attorney employees cited by the union are workforce size, not attendance.

start_date.summary: Reports say the protests began 30 October 2024.

location.summary: Telma reports announcement outside Gostivar court; RFE/RL says actions at regional state attorney offices. The aggregate event footprint/attendance is not resolved.

demands.summary: 30 percent salary supplement; union sought a meeting with government representatives.

participants_original.summary: No attendance figure; the 118 staff figure is not protesters.

state_target.summary: Union requested a meeting with government representatives on supplement for state attorneys.

state_response.summary: Government meeting request had not been answered; no other response established.

notes: Do not interpret 118 employees as attendance. Cross-office simultaneity and gathering-level headcount are unknown.
open_questions: Is there contemporaneous evidence of at least 50 people simultaneously at any one public gathering site? The 118 state-attorney employees are workforce size, and the saved reports do not give protest attendance.
Were actions at the regional state-attorney offices simultaneous and part of one coordinated public event, or should separate office actions remain unaggregated?
Which state institution had authority over the requested 30% supplement, and do the reports establish that this demand was addressed to that own-state authority?
